topic.title: Padmanabhaswamy Temple: the mystery of Vault B
topic.angle: A 2011 court-ordered inventory revealed vast treasure beneath the temple, but Vault B has never been fully opened and counted.
key_facts: Sri Padmanabhaswamy Temple in Thiruvananthapuram has several underground vaults (kallaras)
In 2011 a Supreme Court-appointed team inventoried the vaults
They found gold, precious stones and ancient ornaments; media reports estimated the value at over 1 lakh crore rupees
Vault B has not been fully opened and inventoried; opening it is opposed by many on religious and traditional grounds
In July 2020 the Supreme Court upheld the Travancore royal family's rights in the temple's administration

instagram_caption:
The treasure that shocked the world, and the one vault still unopened. 🔐✨

Beneath Sri Padmanabhaswamy Temple in Thiruvananthapuram lie several vaults. In 2011, a team appointed by the Supreme Court counted what was inside: gold, gems and ancient jewellery, valued in reports at over ₹1 lakh crore. But one vault, Vault B, has never been fully opened and counted. 🏛️
